```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(brandkit)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(gt)
library(DT)
brand_quarto_setup()
```

## gt Table

```{r}
#| label: gt-table
cols <- brand_colors()

gt(head(mtcars[, 1:6], 10)) |>
  tab_header(title = "Motor Trend Cars", subtitle = "First 10 rows") |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = cols$primary),
      cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = cols$light),
    locations = cells_body(rows = seq(1, 10, 2))
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color = cols$primary,
    heading.border.bottom.color = cols$primary
  )
```

## DT Table

```{r}
#| label: dt-table
DT::datatable(
  head(iris, 25),
  options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tip"),
  class = "table-striped",
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

## Faceted Plot

```{r}
#| label: facets
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = drv)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~class, ncol = 4) +
  labs(title = "Highway MPG by Engine Displacement", subtitle = "Faceted by vehicle class")
```

## Bar Chart

```{r}
#| label: bars
ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = drv)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Vehicle Class by Drive Type", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  coord_flip()
```

## Diverging Colour Scale

```{r}
#| label: diverging
cor_mat <- cor(mtcars[, 1:7])
cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat))
names(cor_df) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Correlation")

ggplot(cor_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_brand_div() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)), size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Correlation Matrix — mtcars") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Interactive Plotly

```{r}
#| label: plotly-interactive
p <- ggplot(diamonds |> dplyr::sample_n(500),
            aes(carat, price, color = cut)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(title = "Diamond Price vs Carat")

brand_plotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y", "colour"))
```

## All Palette Types

```{r}
#| label: palettes
#| fig-height: 6
par(mfrow = c(5, 1), mar = c(1, 8, 2, 1))
barplot(rep(1, 15), col = brand_pal_discrete(), border = NA,
        horiz = TRUE, axes = FALSE, main = "Discrete (15)")
barplot(rep(1, 9), col = brand_pal_seq("warm"), border = NA,
        horiz = TRUE, axes = FALSE, main = "Sequential — warm")
barplot(rep(1, 9), col = brand_pal_seq("cool"), border = NA,
        horiz = TRUE, axes = FALSE, main = "Sequential — cool")
barplot(rep(1, 9), col = brand_pal_seq("green"), border = NA,
        horiz = TRUE, axes = FALSE, main = "Sequential — green")
barplot(rep(1, 11), col = brand_pal_div(), border = NA,
        horiz = TRUE, axes = FALSE, main = "Diverging")
```
